text:
Before the meal, the plate held 6 maki sushi pieces. The rolls looked like a mix of salmon-and-cucumber and vegetable types, plus a small portion of pickled ginger and a small dab of wasabi.

Estimating the plate: each piece weighs about 30-35 g, so 6 pieces come to roughly 190 g. At about 1.4 kcal/g for sushi roll, that is about 265 kcal. The ginger is about 15 g (about 10 kcal) and the wasabi about 5 g (about 5 kcal).

After the meal, the plate is empty apart from crumbs. A little ginger or wasabi residue remains in the cups, so I assume nearly everything was eaten. Water is not counted.

Eaten: about 190 g of sushi plus about 15 g of ginger and wasabi, so roughly 205 g and about 270 kcal.

{"kcal": 270, "mass_g": 205}
